{{Otheruses|Trident}}
[[File:Trident_FDCR.png|thumb|300px|A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] holding a trident.]]

A '''trident''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] consisting of a [[Spear/Legends|spear]] with three points at one end.

The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] were known to use tridents underwater during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

[[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] had an image of a trident painted onto his helmet.
